preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 and 2 <= M <= 1000 for N, M in zip(Ns, Ms))
preconditions.description: For each test case, dimensions N and M are between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N * M for B, N, M in zip(Bs, Ns, Ms))
preconditions.description: The length of array B is equal to N * M for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= 10**9 for B in Bs for i in range(len(B)))
preconditions.description: Each element in array B is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(B)) == len(B) for B in Bs)
preconditions.description: All elements in array B are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(grid) == N and all(len(row) == M for row in grid) for grid, N, M in zip(grids, Ns, Ms))
postconditions.description: Each grid has dimensions N x M.

postconditions.expression: all(all(B[i] in grid for i in range(len(B))) for B, grid in zip(Bs, grids))
postconditions.description: Each grid contains all elements of the corresponding array B.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(grid)) == len(grid) for grid in grids)
postconditions.description: All elements in each grid are distinct.
